meta.title: EUR curve definitions: €STR OIS discounting, EURIBOR 6M and 3M projection
meta.description: Stage A's multi-curve dependence (PROBLEM.md section 4): the €STR curve from the overnight fixing and €STR OIS; the 6M EURIBOR curve from the 6M deposit and the standard EUR IRS (fixed annual 30/360 vs 6M), discounted on €STR; the 3M EURIBOR curve from the 3M deposit, eight FEU3 futures (convexity zero, stated) and 3s6s tenor-basis swaps (the spread on the 3M leg), which read the 6M and €STR curves. Knots at the instruments' maturities. Tenors from the conventions' cited standard tenor sets (docs/G4_BUNDLE.md EUR.3-EUR.6).
sources: docs/G4_BUNDLE.md EUR.3 (€STR OIS tenors), EUR.4 (EURIBOR IRS tenors: CFTC MAT), EUR.5 (3s6s basis: spread on the 3M leg, Bianchetti-Carlicchi), EUR.6 (FEU3 periods, EURIBOR deposits)
Bianchetti and Carlicchi, Markets Evolution After the Credit Crunch (arXiv 1301.7078): multiple-curve bootstrapping of the 3M curve from basis swaps against the 6M curve
notes: The choice of the 6M curve as the swap curve and the 3M curve through basis swaps follows the EUR market's standard IRS (vs 6M EURIBOR); the exact instrument selection is a curve-definition matter (own construction).

EUR-ESTR.description: €STR OIS discount curve, linear in the zero rate.

EUR-EURIBOR-6M.description: 6M EURIBOR projection curve from the 6M deposit and fixed-vs-6M swaps, €STR-discounted.

EUR-EURIBOR-3M.description: 3M EURIBOR projection curve from the 3M deposit, eight FEU3 futures and 3s6s basis swaps against the 6M curve, €STR-discounted.
